_comment: Copy to ~/.config/brain-traverse/config.json (all projects) or ./brain-traverse.config.json (one project). Every key is optional except vaultRoot; BRAIN_* env vars override anything set here. Keys starting with _ are ignored; any other unknown key is reported by `brain-traverse config`.
_comment_apiKey: Your TypeSafe Jev key; a self-hosted service needs one only if it checks it. Prefer the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable.
_comment_decisionsUrl: Hosted Jev, or a self-hosted service with the same API, e.g. http://my-server:8081.
